Package net.boricj.bft.dwarf

Class DwarfFile

java.lang.Object
net.boricj.bft.dwarf.DwarfFile
public final class DwarfFile extends Object
Aggregates the modeled DWARF debug sections for one artifact.

      public DwarfFile(ByteOrder byteOrder, DwarfAranges debugAranges, DwarfStringTable debugStrings, DwarfStringTable debugLineStrings, DwarfLineInfo debugLine, DwarfDebugInfo debugInfo)
      Creates a DWARF file view from already parsed section models.
      Parameters:
      byteOrder - shared byte order for all sections
      debugAranges - .debug_aranges section model
      debugStrings - .debug_str section model, or null
      debugLineStrings - .debug_line_str section model, or null
      debugLine - .debug_line section model
      debugInfo - .debug_info section model
